opening.argument: The presentation makes participation depend on paid packages, ranging from “hundred euros” to five thousand euros, while directing viewers to invite many others and share the opportunity widely. It then presents recruitment within a growing organization alongside binary compensation plans, urging viewers to “lock in your position” because those plans are powerful and fast growing. The appeal is strengthened by speculative appreciation, with the speaker saying a hundredfold increase would mean “retirement time.” Together, the paid entry, emphasis on team recruitment and tiered compensation, and promise of exceptional wealth present OneCoin participation as an opportunity to buy in, build a network, and profit from hoped-for growth.
